boundary.certified_strict: Pass 582 gives explicit strict one-step continuous neighborhoods. Pass 577 gives finite-grid infinite-horizon strictness for conservative and nominal profiles.
boundary.open: An unconditional continuous infinite-horizon strict inequality at every interior belief is not asserted. The aspirational uniform prior remains a tie at grid denominators 12, 18, and 24, identifying a real candidate decision-affinity surface.
boundary.proved: Global infinite-horizon continuous non-worsening, by an explicit same-cost pathwise lift of every baseline policy; and a necessary-and-sufficient strict Blackwell decision criterion.

theorem.full_support_nontriviality: All declared likelihoods are positive and every added channel separates the hidden coordinate omitted by its baseline marginal. Therefore failure of strictness can occur only on a genuine decision-affinity/tie surface, not because the joint experiment is statistically equivalent to the baseline experiment.
theorem.global_infinite_horizon_order: For every prior p and every baseline stopping policy pi, the lifted augmented policy has no larger Bayes terminal loss. Taking infima gives V_aug(p) <= V_base(p) on the full continuous simplex.
theorem.pathwise_policy_lift: Replace each baseline Q_k by J_k and each baseline orientation action O by J_0. Feed only the garbled marginal to the original policy and retain the extra output. The stopping time and pathwise sensing cost are unchanged.
theorem.strictness_criterion: The inequality is strict whenever, on a positive-probability terminal history of a baseline-optimal policy, the optimal terminal decision using the refined transcript is not measurable with respect to the garbled baseline transcript. Equivalently, the baseline continuation Bayes risk is non-affine along at least one extra-signal posterior split.
